Quin goes to the dock with Jax.
They sit on the dock and look at the ships.
Jax looks up and sees a big clock. “What is that clock for?” he asks.
“There is a bell in the clock. When the bell rings, the ships can go to the dock” says Quin.

slides.text: Quin and Jax look for ships that could go to the dock.  | “I think that tall black ship will go to the dock,” said Quin.  | “I think this big pink ship will go to the dock,” said Jax.  | The bell rings. Ding dong. Ding dong.  | Which ship will go to the dock?
